ocv_candidate: Scale the supplied monotone OCV variation about SOC 0.95, plus the existing common offset. One new shared parameter; preserve the original plant equations and use predicted SOC.
cr_profile_rule: Refit all remaining parameters on training only; diagnose relative objective increase. This is not a likelihood confidence interval.
fit_selection: Minimum training composite objective among declared starts, frozen before evaluating 588/600; no post-evaluation retuning.

cabin_observer.type: augmented linear heat-state and constant sensor-bias observer
cabin_observer.initial_temperature: first biased reading, not hidden true state
cabin_observer.scope: Model-based bias estimation in simulation, not real hardware calibration. Disturbance and parameter mismatch may prevent strict terminal accuracy.

selection_scope: New observer and battery return are the same for baseline and optimized policies. Previous failures are known design cases; additional 30/35/45C and 60/120-minute cases are transfer diagnostics, not independent measured validation.
claim_limits: No real cabin or battery temperature measurements
No AI-run check is team independent work or manual verification
